VPN isn't particularly safe. You just choose to give your personal information to a network in a different company/country, rather than giving it to your internet provider. Somebody will see your data, one way or another.

I prefer to use Tor browser instead. It's quite slow, but rather than redirecting your personal information it just completely decodes it, so nobody can see what you are doing (all your internet provider or VPN host can see is that you are using Tor, they cannot see what you are searching).
